name: huaweicloud-api-docs
title: 华为云API文档
description: Find and summarize official Huawei Cloud API documentation from Huawei Cloud Help Center and Huawei Cloud developer properties. Use when the user asks about Huawei Cloud APIs, API references, developer guides, endpoints, authentication, SDKs, API Explorer, error codes, or service-specific documentation such as OBS, ECS, VPC, RDS, CCE, ELB, IAM, or GaussDB. Prefer official Huawei Cloud documentation. If the current role does not have web tools, provide official Huawei Cloud entry links and explain the limitation instead of guessing.
